<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex031012026-09-1508-46-53" status="reviewed"><note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4207">me</rs> na re</note><note type="editorial">Tentative identification as Me tik pa, who is mentioned above as well. Could also be Me lhang tshe (ID:6655)</note> 'o na <note type="gloss">thag ring po na gnas pa'i <choice><reg>ra</reg><orig>(ra)</orig></choice> chen por 'dzin pa ma 'khrul bar thal lo zhe na |</note>
         <note type="gloss">chung ngu la chen por 'dzin pa yang tshad mar <expan>thal lo</expan> zhes pa'i</note> thal ba'i dam bca' la <note type="gloss">bsal ba gtong ba</note> gnod pa ni <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3834">rgya</rs> na re</note> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3834">kho bo</rs>'i skabs don la nye bar mkho ba <note type="gloss">ste 'dod pa kho na</note> yin no ||</seg></TEI>
